key_findings: Graduate Studies Application is an application page, not a programme record.
Official TUM Asia wording says master applicants need not submit GRE or GATE; these tests should not be extracted as requirements.
Central current graduate requirements state related bachelor's degree, English proof unless waived, and APS for China, India, or Vietnam degree holders.
Rail and Urban Transport has current readable programme facts: M.Sc., 120 ECTS, August 2026 intake, and 1 Oct 2025 to 31 Mar 2026 application period.
Integrated Circuit Design and Green Electronics current seed pages were not text-readable here, so programme-specific close dates and fees require manual confirmation.
known_gaps: This draft structures the three TUM Asia seed programmes plus central admissions pages, not the full TUM Asia graduate catalogue.

Current HTML for Green Electronics and Integrated Circuit Design returned a JavaScript-required page in the available official-site reader; official older PDFs were used only for programme identity and academic background.
Programme-specific language thresholds may differ from the central current graduate requirement and should be manually verified before publication.
